entities.summary: Bill Justinussen is a Faroese politician who served as Minister of Health from 2002 to 2004. He also was the President of the West Nordic Council from 2014 to 2015, and the chairman of the Centre Party from 1997 to 1999. He has also been a Member of the Løgting since 2003.
